Below is a ready-to-run Python script you can use locally. It looks for daily entries for the dates 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-27, finds the content for Perplexity’s answers on each date, extracts all cited http/https links, normalizes domains (removes leading www.), and prints the unique-domain count plus the domains themselves.

Python script (usage: set record_url to the Namebeam record page URL and run):


import requests
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
from urllib.parse import urlparse
import datetime
import re

record_url = "https://example.com/path/to/namebeam-ai-visibility-record"  # <-- replace this
start = datetime.date(2026, 9, 1)
end = datetime.date(2026, 9, 27)

def normalize_domain(url):
    try:
        p = urlparse(url)
        if p.scheme not in ("http", "https"):
            return None
        host = p.hostname or ""
        host = host.lower()
        if host.startswith("www."):
            host = host[4:]
        return host
    except:
        return None

r = requests.get(record_url, timeout=20)
r.raise_for_status()
soup = BeautifulSoup(r.text, "html.parser")

domains = set()

date = start
while date <= end:
    date_str = date.isoformat()  # "2026-09-01"
    # Find an element that contains the date text
    date_elems = soup.find_all(string=re.compile(re.escape(date_str)))
    for s in date_elems:
        parent = s if hasattr(s, "parent") else None
        if parent is None:
            continue
        # Search upwards a few levels for a container for that day
        container = parent
        for _ in range(6):
            if container is None:
                break
            text = container.get_text(" ", strip=True)
            # check that this container also mentions "Perplexity" somewhere
            if "Perplexity" in text:
                # find links inside this container
                for a in container.find_all("a", href=True):
                    href = a["href"]
                    d = normalize_domain(href)
                    if d:
                        domains.add(d)
                # also find any bare http(s) links in the container text
                for href in re.findall(r"https?://[^\s)'\"]+", text):
                    d = normalize_domain(href)
                    if d:
                        domains.add(d)
                break
            container = container.parent
    date = date + datetime.timedelta(days=1)

print("Unique domains cited by Perplexity from 2026-09-01 to 2026-09-27:", len(domains))
for d in sorted(domains):
    print(d)

Notes and tips
- If Namebeam has one page per day, replace the single-page fetch with per-date URLs and fetch each page separately (iterate date and request a page URL template).
- If the record uses a different visible date format (e.g., "September 1, 2026"), adjust the date matching accordingly.
- If Perplexity’s citations are inside a clearly labeled element (e.g., class="perplexity-answer"), change the selection to soup.select(".perplexity-answer") to be more precise and faster.
